# proxmox_cluster_firewall_options (Resource)

Manages Proxmox VE cluster-wide firewall options through `/cluster/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_cluster_firewall_options" "cluster" {
  enable         = true
  ebtables       = true
  policy_in      = "DROP"
  policy_out     = "ACCEPT"
  policy_forward = "DROP"
  log_ratelimit  = "enable=1,burst=5,rate=1/second"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ebtables` (Boolean) Enable ebtables rules cluster-wide.
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the firewall cluster-wide.
- `log_ratelimit` (String) Proxmox log rate-limit property string, for example `enable=1,burst=5,rate=1/second`.
- `policy_forward` (String) Default forwarded traffic policy: `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `policy_in` (String) Default incoming traffic policy: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, or `DROP`.
- `policy_out` (String) Default outgoing traffic policy: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, or `DROP`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The fixed identifier `cluster`.
